exact_statement: For actual Boolean signs on finite uniform cubes with entropy in bits, let C_* be the extended supremum of H/I over nonconstants. Fixed-dimensional maxima M_n exist, increase to C_*, and satisfy M_n<=n*2^(n-1). For every finite 0<=C<C_*, there exists a witness H>CI of least essential physical dimension; such witnesses approximate C_* along thresholds approaching C_* (or increasing to infinity). Disjoint tensor products add H,I,D_C and violating products have a violating factor. Balancing k tensor copies gives deficit kD_C-C. Balanced singleton activation has H=pH(g)+2rp(2-p)+h((1-p)^2), I=p(I(g)+r). For every nonconstant f, the activated balanced sequence k=m^2,r=m has R tending to R(f) with I and minority probability tending to zero. These operations preserve threshold admission after sufficient amplification but do not generally preserve dimension-criticality; arbitrary restriction need not preserve H/I. No global optimizer attainment is asserted.
hypotheses: Actual Boolean signs on finite uniform cubes
Entropy in bits; constants never divided by influence
Fixed finite C>=0; existence of a violation where criticality is invoked

exact_statement: Fix finite C>=0 and an actual Boolean dimension-critical C-witness f, meaning H(f)>CI(f) and its essential physical dimension is minimal among all such witnesses. Every proper physical restriction has deficit D_C<=0, and f has no proper nonconstant disjoint tensor factorization. For every nonempty block A of its essential coordinates, L_A-CI_A>=D_C(f)>0, with L_A=H(f)-E H(f_a)=H(Z_A|Z_Ac)+I(a;T), where a is uniform and T is sampled from the actual child Fourier spectrum. Every finite adaptive physical restriction tree satisfies D_C(f)=sum_internal pi_v(L_v-Cd_v)+sum_leaves pi_lD_C(f_l); with proper leaves the internal sum is at least D_C(f). No component-pruning, connectedness, or inherited descendant-criticality conclusion is asserted.
